links.outcome: Diagnostic and management accuracy of a RAG-grounded system versus a general LLM, scored against AAO guidelines
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o scored higher than the RAG-based Infiniti AI on diagnosis (2.37 vs 1.13, p<0.001), management (2.65 vs 1.98, p<0.001) and total score (5.00 vs 3.10, p<0.001). Both models remained prone to hallucinations.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o significantly outperformed Infiniti AI across all categories.

screen.reason: The study compares the diagnostic and management performance of a general LLM (ChatGPT-4o) versus a specialized RAG-based LLM (Infiniti AI) on 20 corneal clinical vignettes scored by an expert. It does not test a deployment practice or organizational safeguard intervention.
